μ.m: Lower-case mu (μῦ), the 12th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the bilabial nasal /m/. It is preceded by λ and followed by ν

n: The letter mu (μῦ), the 12th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.
A digit 10,000 in the decimal acrophonic numeral system that predated the gematria system. An abbreviation of μυριάς (muriás, “myriad”). Equivalent to the Roman digit ↂ, i.e. ⅭⅭⅠↃↃ.
